stylesheets.cssText:
.market-offer-card > footer > button[data-buy-offer]:disabled, .market-offer-card > footer > button[data-buy-offer][aria-busy="true"] { cursor: default !important; }
.market-offer-card > footer > button[data-buy-offer].market-offer-unavailable { border-color: rgb(133, 84, 90) !important; background: linear-gradient(rgb(74, 37, 43), rgb(50, 28, 33)) !important; color: rgb(255, 184, 188) !important; cursor: not-allowed !important; }
.worldmap-panel--map .map-canvas { margin-inline: auto; min-width: 0px !important; }

#auth-screen:not(.hidden) ~ #app { visibility: hidden !important; pointer-events: none !important; }
html:has(#auth-screen:not(.hidden)) body :is(#reference-hud, #game-chat, #shiny-global-next, #online-members-hud, #move-priority-panel, #rare-capture-feed) { display: none !important; }

.auth-public-guides { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; color: rgb(169, 201, 193); font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-weight: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: calc(13px * var(--ui-text-factor, 1)); line-height: 1.6; font-family: Arial; padding: 10px 12px; }
.auth-public-guides a { color: rgb(199, 228, 215); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

#mailbox-system .mailbox-reward-art > .trainer-equipment-art { position: relative !important; inset: auto !important; transform: none !important; width: 28px !important; height: 28px !important; min-width: 28px !important; display: block !important; }
.settings-banner-hidden { display: none !important; }

#diamond-shop-system .diamond-offer-art > img.diamond-vip-package-art { filter: drop-shadow(rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.667) 0px 7px 9px); position: relative !important; inset: auto !important; display: block !important; width: 92px !important; height: 92px !important; max-width: calc(100% - 12px) !important; max-height: calc(100% - 12px) !important; margin: auto !important; object-fit: contain !important; object-position: center center !important; transform: none !important; }
.hunt-analyzer-head > span:first-child::before { display: none !important; }
#stage .viewport-controls-rail > .skill-opacity-control, #stage > .skill-opacity-control { display: none !important; }
#profession-system .profession-recipe > footer { display: grid !important; visibility: visible !important; opacity: 1 !important; }

body.test-environment #stage > #game { display: block !important; visibility: visible !important; opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; z-index: 1 !important; }
body.test-environment #stage > #game-hd-output { display: none !important; }

.pokelog-limit-note[data-pokelog-scroll-status] { display: block; min-height: 18px; padding: 6px 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(70, 118, 124, 0.18); color: rgb(120, 161, 159); font-size: calc(6px * var(--ui-text-factor, 1)); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.2px; text-align: center; }

#player-context-menu.player-context-menu { isolation: isolate; position: fixed !important; z-index: 260000 !important; }
#player-context-menu.player-context-menu:not(.hidden) { pointer-events: auto; }

#profession-system .profession-load-status { display: block; margin: 12px auto 4px; padding: 8px 12px; color: rgb(143, 177, 175); font-size: calc(8px * var(--ui-text-factor, 1)); font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-align: center; }
#profession-system .profession-load-status[hidden] { display: none !important; }

html body #stage .panel.auto-helper-panel:not(.client-open), html body #stage .panel.hunt-analyzer-panel:not(.client-open) { display: none !important; visibility: hidden !important; pointer-events: none !important; }

#topidle-vote-system .topidle-reward-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0px, 1fr)); }
#topidle-vote-system .topidle-reward-grid article { grid-column: span 1; }
